tasks.title: Password loop
tasks.starter:
PASSWORD = "gold"
attempt = input()
while attempt != PASSWORD:
    print("Incorrect. Try again.")
    attempt = input()
print("Access granted.")

tests.output:
Incorrect. Try again.
Incorrect. Try again.
Access granted.
